showcase.headline: Your whole clinic, calm in one place.
showcase.lead: Enquiries become appointments, appointments become patients, and every visit flows into notes, treatments and payments — no more WhatsApp threads, paper registers or spreadsheets.

checkIn.title: Checked in at the front desk

inStep.title: Every room in step
inStep.body: Front desk, doctors, therapists, the pharmacy and accounts work from one live record.

nothingSlips.title: Nothing slips through
nothingSlips.body: Follow-ups, dues and low-stock medicines come to you before anyone has to remember them.

calm.title: Calm by design
calm.body: Colour-coded rooms your team reads at a glance, even on the busiest day.

showcase.privacy: Private by design — each clinic sees only its own records.
